- Allow access to your microphone and camera if prompted.

- Open the Google Calendar event for your meeting.
- Click "Join Zoom Meeting."
- If a pop-up appears, click "Open zoom.us" to launch the meeting.

- Go to [indeed.zoom.us](https://indeed.zoom.us).
- Click "Join a meeting."
- Enter the Meeting ID and Passcode from your invite.
- Click "Join."

### 4. If Joining from a Meeting Room or Training Room

- Use the room's Zoom Controller panel to join or initiate the meeting.
- Make sure the AV system is powered on and set to Zoom mode.
- For specific instructions, see the guides for Seattle, Hyderabad, or Sydney meeting spaces if relevant.

### 5. Additional Tips

- Double-check the meeting link, ID, and passcode for typos.
- If you see a message that the meeting is locked, the host may have restricted access after starting the meeting. In this case, contact the meeting host to unlock it.
- Try a different browser or device if you continue to have issues.
